title: Majili
desc: After being abandoned by his lover, Anshu, Poorna takes to alcohol and is forced to marry his neighbour, Sravani. However, he soon discovers her unrequited love for him and falls for her.

desc: A carefree young man faces harsh realities and rapid maturity when he becomes the target of a corrupt politician's vengeance, challenging his values and resilience.

desc: A vengeful businessman pushes a young woman to attempt suicide over his son's death. Her doctor brother saves her and pledges to eradicate their enemies.

title: Vaaliban
desc: The aging warrior faces a sworn enemy in the fateful encounter-don't miss it!

desc: Eight years after Rakesh Mahadkar's reign of terror, a new killer with a Smiley Mask emerges. Two lovesick men navigate their twisted paths, blurring lines between hero and villain.

title: Boomika
desc: A group surveys a secluded property for renovations, but is terrified by a sinister message from a communicating spirit.

title: Arjun
